incident_description:
Impact Summary
Between 21:50 UTC 18 April 2026 and 14:15 UTC 19 April 2026, customers using the Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly known as Databricks Asset Bundles) for automated CI/CD bundle deployments may experience delays or failures impacting deployments that require downloading and verifying the Terraform binary. This issue is caused by the key used for checksum verification having expired on April 18.

Symptoms
Customers may observe:
Failures in CI/CD pipelines when executing Databricks CLI bundle deployment commands.
Errors indicating a failure in GPG checksum verification during the installation process for the Terraform binary.
A widespread inability to perform automated deployments.

Current Status
This incident has been fully resolved as of 19 April 2026, 14:15 UTC. 
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.
